judged_text: The authorization check combines isTeamAdmin and isTeamOwner with && instead of ||, so a user must be BOTH the team admin AND the team owner to satisfy the team-permission branch. Any team admin who is not also the team owner is wrongly rejected with FORBIDDEN, and because the same expression is the only team-based path, the gate as written either over-restricts admins or — if someone later 'fixes' the surrounding code — silently widens who can mutate any booking's attendees; as-is it is a broken authorization gate on a mutation that writes to arbitrary bookings and triggers emails/calendar updates.

adjudication.rationale: In `addGuests.handler.ts`, the team-permission check is computed as `(await isTeamAdmin(...)) && (await isTeamOwner(...))`, which requires the user to be both admin and owner to pass (`isTeamAdminOrOwner`). This will incorrectly reject legitimate team admins who are not also owners with `FORBIDDEN` on the new `addGuests` mutation, which writes to bookings and triggers calendar/email updates.
